instruction: Visit the Apple navigation patterns page and extract the content from the 'Tab Bars' section. Save it to a document with the exact filename 'tab_bars_guide.docx' on the desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Apple navigation patterns, extracting Tab Bars section, and saving with specific filename. Evaluator verifies (1) file exists with exact filename 'tab_bars_guide.docx' on desktop, (2) file contains substantive content, and (3) content includes Tab Bars related keywords (tab bar, navigation, tab, apple, ios), ensuring agent actually extracted the content rather than just creating an empty file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all verifiable requirements: (1) filename matches 'tab_bars_guide.docx', (2) file contains substantive content, (3) content is semantically related to Tab Bars navigation
Getter properly extracts .docx content using python-docx or XML parsing fallback, returning full text content
Metric implements multi-aspect verification with weighted scoring: filename match (40%), content presence (20%), keyword relevance (40%)
Keyword validation requires at least 2/5 relevant terms ('tab bar', 'navigation', 'tab', 'apple', 'ios'), preventing trivial empty file bypass
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly from get_rule and accesses expected.get('filename') and expected.get('keywords') properly
Edge cases handled: missing file returns None, empty content detected, parsing failures gracefully handled
Partial credit scoring is logical and fair for multi-aspect verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider stricter keyword threshold: Currently requires 2/5 keywords which is relatively permissive. Could increase to 3/5 for more robust validation
Consider adding minimum content length check: Require content to be at least N characters to prevent minimal text gaming
Consider case-insensitive keyword matching with word boundaries: Current implementation uses simple substring matching which could have false positives
